WEBSITE DESIGN & DEVELOPMENT

A website that makes your
business easier to understand.

Your website should explain what you do, show why it matters, and help visitors take the next step. I combine content structure, visual design, and development to build that experience.

Best suited to

  • Businesses launching their first website
  • Businesses replacing an unclear or outdated site
  • Campaigns needing a focused landing page
  • Agencies needing additional delivery capacity

Define the website you need.

Your proposal defines the exact pages, features, and deliverables. Depending on the project, these can include:

  • Sitemap and page structure
  • Content guidance
  • Custom responsive layouts
  • Website development on the agreed platform
  • Forms and agreed integrations
  • Technical SEO foundations
  • Accessibility and performance checks
  • Launch preparation and handover

Request a tailored quote.

Pricing depends on the pages, functionality, content readiness, and integrations required. Hosting, licences, substantial copywriting, and ongoing support are included only when specified in the proposal.

What I need from you

Before development, we agree who supplies copy, images, access, and approvals. The schedule accounts for these dependencies.

Before development begins

How long does a website take?+

The schedule depends on scope, content readiness, integrations, and approval turnaround. Milestones and dependencies are agreed before work begins.

How do revisions work?+

Your proposal sets the review stages and revision rounds. Additional requests are assessed for cost and schedule impact before work proceeds.

What happens after launch?+

You receive the agreed access and handover documentation. Maintenance and further improvements can be arranged separately.

Who owns the website and files?+

Ownership, licences, account access, and source-file delivery are documented in the agreement.

Can the website connect to my existing tools?+

We define the required systems and visitor tasks during scoping. Access, provider capabilities, and integration work are agreed in the proposal.
